title: Staffing and outsourcing for companies — the Source-to-Operations model | Alimat Group
desc: Temporary staffing, process outsourcing and permanent recruitment. 15 years of experience, 52 partner companies, 3,000+ workers a year.
h1: Workers and teams for your company
lead: An integrated model for managing people and operational processes — from sourcing workers to smoothly running teams.
about_p1: For **15 years we have been connecting companies with workers from all over the world**, helping to build stable teams that genuinely support business growth.
about_quote: We build every partnership on responsibility, mutual trust and an understanding of each company's individual needs.
about_p2: We believe effective recruitment does not end at the moment of hiring. Its real value is **well-functioning teams** within our Partners' organisations.
about_p3: The **Source-to-Operations** model is end-to-end support for companies, from sourcing workers to smoothly running teams.
group_lead: Each company is responsible for a specialised area. Together they let us safely take over the entire operational process — from sourcing a worker to managing teams at the Partner's site.
group_center: One partner, one system — from recruitment to the day-to-day running of processes.
brands: HR, payroll, accounting, legalisation and administration.
models_lead: Cooperation tailored to the needs, scale and pace of growth of your company.

p: We provide workers in response to seasonality, increased demand, absences or rapid changes in your organisation.
Alimat Group is responsible for employing the workers and handling all formalities, while the client, as the user employer, organises their daily work and supervises the tasks.
list: less organisational burden on the client's side
models.note: Flexible support that helps keep work continuous and respond quickly to operational needs.

p: The client entrusts us with an entire selected process or part of it and defines the expected scope and result. We provide a properly prepared team, our own leaders and the organisation of daily work.
The client's management agrees day-to-day matters with Alimat Group leaders, who assign tasks to the team, supervise their execution and coordinate the whole outsourced area.
list: takeover of a whole process or part of it
team managed by Alimat Group leaders
clear communication between the client's management and our leaders
models.client_d: Defines the needs, scope and expected result.
models.us_d: Organises the team, manages the work and is responsible for delivery and continuity of the process.
models.note: The client defines the needs and the expected result; we are responsible for organising, delivering and keeping the outsourced process running.

models.sub: A candidate found for your organisation
p: Based on your defined needs, we source and verify suitable candidates.
Once the process is complete, the selected person is employed directly by the client.
list: access to candidates from international markets
selection matched to your organisation's requirements
models.note: We are responsible for finding the right candidate; the client gains an employee ready for long-term cooperation.

consulting: Need support with HR and personnel policy? See HR consulting
flow_t: Working with Alimat Group in three steps
flow_lead: A simple process. A partnership approach. A shared goal.

flow.t: We get to know you and match
flow.d: We get to know the client's organisation and together choose the best cooperation model.
items: First contact
We agree on the date and place of a meeting.
Needs analysis
We learn about the business and the client's staffing needs.
Site visit
We visit the plant and analyse the working conditions.
Choosing the model
We select the solution that fits the organisation's needs.
Preparing the offer
We present the scope, terms and principles of cooperation.
Signing the contract
We finalise the arrangements and start working together.

flow.d: We put the arrangements into practice and prepare the workers to start.
items: Recruitment
We use our own candidate database and recruit on international markets.
Verification
We check experience, skills and readiness for work.
Legalisation
We coordinate the formalities of legal residence and work.
Employment
We prepare the paperwork in line with the cooperation model.
Relocation and logistics
We organise arrival, accommodation and transport for the workers, using our own solutions or the client's infrastructure.

flow.d: We help get the cooperation started smoothly and provide support matched to the chosen model.
items: Onboarding and preparation
We prepare workers for their duties, run the required training and support their onboarding at the client's site.
Team management*
We coordinate the team's work, taking care of communication, organisation and continuity of tasks.
KPIs, reporting and optimisation*
We monitor agreed indicators, report results and improve the processes together.
flow.foot: * Depending on the agreed cooperation model.

ind_t: Teams matched to the realities of your industry
ind_lead: Every sector has its own needs, pace of work and requirements. That is why we build teams suited to the environment they will work in.

cta_t: Let's match the cooperation model to your organisation's needs
cta_d: Process outsourcing, temporary staffing or permanent recruitment? Together we will choose a solution that takes into account the scale of demand, the job profiles, the location and how work is organised.
